raw_definitions: Definisi : adj & adv ( taboo & offensive outside intimate circles ), ( preceding v, also ~ well ) sial, celaka, [ not translated ]: I got on the wrong ~ train and had to get off at King’s Cross, saya naik kereta api yg salah dan terpaksa turun di King’s Cross, celaka betul!; where’s that ~ passport?, di mana pasport sial itu?; if he won’t do it, we’ll have to ~ well make him, kalau dia tak mahu membuatnya, kita paksa dia saja. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
